>
[Animal Soul Siblings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5251) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 79

</column>

---

Your eyes have been opened to the spiritual essence suffusing the world. You gain [_speak with animals_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1680) as a primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You get a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=2391) from animals.
